name: Koi Fish
summary: Original small three-colour ornamental koi with an embedded looping body, tail and pectoral swim.
description: Lightweight P3 atrium pond koi. Original analytic geometry, pearl/red/ink vertex colours, rounded paired fins, forked caudal, opercular creases and four short barbels. A separate mall-sized delivery because the existing fish-koi files do not meet this task budgets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic analytic Blender Python geometry and vertex colours. No external models, textures, reference images, fonts or brands.

display.origin: Floor centre of reference pose envelope

material_notes: Three shared opaque vertex-colour materials; no textures, transparency, external resources or exported lights. One exported mesh definition split into three material primitives.
accuracy_notes: Original stylized ornamental koi; artist-tuned in-place swimming, not taxonomic identification, an animal-care specification, water simulation or pond navigation. Transform the whole loaded glTF scene; the skinned mesh is a scene root. Physical devices, WebKit and full-mall performance are not tested.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, analytic pigment islands and materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner’s projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
